paragraphs: Rabbi Yochanan ben Shaul: Kol HaKelim 125b, Challon 81a, Sotah 46a. Rabbi Levi transmitted in his name: Shocher Tov, section 105. Sanhedrin 57a and 74a: Rabbi Yonatan ben Shaul. Yuchasin likewise writes ‘Yonatan ben Shaul, Kol HaKelim, Rabbi’s student’; perhaps it is a scribal error. His brother was Yose; see his entry.
